result.title: AR-Edit: Training-Free Autoregressive Video Editing without Inversion
result.summary: Editing a video stream in real time, without access to future frames, is essential for interactive applications. Existing training-free video editing methods, however, assume full offline access to the entire sequence, while streaming approaches either rely on additional training or are limited to specific editing techniques. We show that this limitation can be removed by analyzing the self-attention dynamics of DMD-distilled autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models. We uncover a key asymmetry: queries and keys remain stable and aligned with their source counterparts across denoising timesteps, while values diverge and encode the evolving content. Inherited from the non-distilled bidirectional teacher, this asymmetry is strongest at high noise, where few-step streaming models operate. The resulting mechanism is simple: a single forward pass suffices to capture source identity in the value features, which can be reused throughout generation. Starting from pure Gaussian noise and injecting only these source values reconstructs the input with fidelity matching or surpassing inversion-based methods, effectively eliminating inversion. Based on this insight, we introduce AR-Edit, a training-free, inversion-free method that caches source values once and selectively injects them during denoising. Across multiple AR backbones, AR-Edit enables real-time streaming editing with superior source preservation and tonal fidelity at minimal overhead.

AI.brief_summary: 该文分析 DMD 蒸馏的自回归视频扩散模型的自注意力动态，发现去噪过程中 query/key 稳定、value 发散并承载内容，据此提出无需训练、无需 inversion 的 AR-Edit：缓存一次源视频的 value 特征并在去噪中按需注入，实现实时流式视频编辑。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「Q/K 稳定而 V 承载内容」的注意力分量分工及跨去噪步缓存复用的观察，可能为 LVR 中视觉内容驻留位置、latent 缓存与相似度分析的解读提供核查线索，但论文本身属视频编辑，未涉及推理。
